round1_status.evidence: To do card above 'Connect mail' (inbox-todos.png); full 'No mail connected' page only when no meeting source (plan S5).
Plan Deliberate choices: the '{title}, {date}' line is not tappable. Open in Granola is reachable from the chat citation popover.
Plan Deliberate choices: the sidebar Inbox badge stays mail-only. Residual noted as F2-IF-1-02.
Mobile frame draws the '2 more' collapse (mob-inbox-todos.png). Persistence on reload is a plan matter (S5).
Web checkbox label is 32 px; mobile target is the row (but see F2-IF-1-01).

findings.description: Mobile mockup completes a to-do when the user taps anywhere on the row; the mockup comment says the whole row is the 44 pt target. The plan says a meeting row has no tap action and only the checkbox acts.
findings.expected: Mockup and plan agree: row tap does nothing, circle (with a 44 pt hit area) completes.
findings.actual: Click on any part of .ir.td hides the row (script), circle is 24x24 px.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the mockup script and comment to match the plan, or change the plan.

findings.description: Nothing signals that new meeting to-dos arrived (badge stays mail-only by decision). A meeting-only founder has to open Inbox on her own.
findings.actual: Sidebar shows 'Inbox' with no count in every state.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep as decided; revisit with usage data.

findings.description: A meeting-only user sees 'Connect Gmail to read, sort and answer your mail here.' permanently under the to-dos.
findings.expected: Card is dismissible or hidden for users who chose not to use mail.
findings.actual: Persistent card in syncing, empty, todos and consent states.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: allow dismissing; otherwise accept as the plan's FX-14.
